theme_strategy.rationale: A LinkedIn CRM demands command-center focus, data clarity, and legibility over long periods. We use a Deep Obsidian base anchored with vivid functional blue to reflect professional networking, while maintaining an ultra-sleek, dense tactical look suitable for a power user.

rules: Use tinted greys (Zinc/Slate) rather than pure black.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit hover colors that are lighter hues of the active state.
Never use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays, sidebars, or headers.
Use uppercase tracking-[0.2em] for overlines and tiny labels.
Keep body line-height loose (leading-relaxed) and headers tight (leading-none).

layouts.global_structure: Sidebar Navigation (left) + Top Header (Account Switcher & Search) + Main Content Area (right).
layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (MODE B) with grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 and tight gap-4 or gap-6.
layouts.kanban_board: Horizontal scrolling flex container with vertical lists (flex-col) for lead stages. Strict max-heights to allow internal scrolling of columns.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy for macro layouts (p-6, p-8). Tight padding (p-3, p-4) for dense data components.
rules: Grid items MUST be direct children.
Use optical alignment for icons with text.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Neumorphism (Tactile) for dashboard widgets: flat background matching parent, 1px subtle border, sharp corners or max 8px border-radius.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-950/80 for sticky headers and modal overlays with a 1px border-white/10 inner stroke.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Use subtle ASCII art or faint monochromatic illustrations to make empty states feel purposeful rather than broken.

component_strategy.base: Heavily utilize Shadcn UI components for Tables, Select, Dropdown, Tabs, Dialogs, Cards.
component_strategy.customization: Override default Shadcn styles to strip out generic look. Make borders sharper, reduce corner radiuses (rounded-md max).
component_strategy.charting: Use Recharts or Shadcn Chart components for KPIs. Keep charts monochromatic or use brand blue + neutral accents.
component_strategy.break_monolith: Break LinkedInSearch.jsx into modular files: SidebarNav, KanbanBoard, ContactCard, ActivityTimeline, BulkMessageComposer, CampaignManager.
component_strategy.toast: Use Sonner for all notifications, configured for dark mode.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states with slight lift (-translate-y-0.5), focus states (ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2 ring-offset-background).
motion.transitions: Specific transitions ONLY (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform). BANNED: transition-all.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in for lists and grid items.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for large text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='send-bulk-message-button').

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) or Lucide React for crisp, dense dashboard icons.
media.images: Use realistic user avatars for leads and connections.

image_urls.description: Male professional headshot for contact detail cards
Female professional headshot for connection lists
Female professional in red cardigan for alternate avatar

instructions_to_main_agent: You are tasked with overhauling a 1162 line monolith (LinkedInSearch.jsx) into a multi-view CRM.
Set up a layout with a fixed sidebar (SidebarNav) and a main content area containing a TopHeader (for multi-account switching) and dynamic views.
Implement routing or state-based view switching for: Dashboard, Search, Kanban Board, Campaigns, and Settings.
For the Kanban Board, create draggable or visually segmented columns (New Lead, Connected, Messaged, Replied, Follow-up, Converted).
Integrate bulk actions (checkboxes on lists -> bulk message/connect action bar).
All new files should be placed in /app/frontend/src/components/crm/ using .js or .jsx extensions.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide. Install them if missing.
Ensure all buttons, tabs, and interactive elements have robust data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop'. Make the CRM look high-end, dense, and hyper-functional.
Use specific layered shadows and crisp 1px borders.
NEVER use `transition: all`. Use specific property transitions.
NEVER center-align the app container. Text and dense data must be left-aligned for scanning.
Always use modern pill-shaped or sharp button styles with interactive states.
NEVER use emojis as icons. Use the specified icon library.
Implement micro-animations on all hover states.
Never use placeholder image services like via.placeholder.com. Use the provided image_urls for avatars.
